en.title: Resident Evil Franchise Sells 5 Million in Just 3 Months
en.summary: Capcom's iconic survival horror series continues its reign, moving an astounding five million units in a single quarter. This surge is driven by both fresh releases and the enduring appeal of its back catalog.
en.body:
Capcom has once again proven the enduring power of the **Resident Evil** franchise, announcing that an incredible five million units across the series were sold in just the last three months. This staggering figure underscores the brand's consistent appeal and Capcom's continued success in revitalizing its beloved survival horror titles.

The latest numbers reveal that the **Resident Evil 4** remake alone accounted for a significant portion of these sales, moving 1.1 million copies in the recent quarter. This adds to its already impressive performance since its 2023 launch, with the game now having sold over five million copies in the past year. The consistent performance of older titles is equally remarkable; **Resident Evil Village**, originally released in 2021, sold an additional 3.6 million copies during the same mid-2025 through mid-2026 period. This sustained sales momentum for games released years ago highlights the franchise's deep bench and Capcom's effective long-term management of its IP.

## A Legacy of Survival

Capcom's commitment to expanding the **Resident Evil** universe, coupled with strategic remakes and consistent quality, has cemented its status as a pillar of the gaming industry. The cumulative sales for the franchise now stand at an impressive 218 million units worldwide, a testament to decades of innovation and terrifying experiences. This recent sales surge places the back catalog of **Resident Evil** games at its strongest point in the company's history, a feat few franchises can claim.

## What This Means for Fans

For fans, these numbers are more than just statistics; they represent a vibrant and healthy franchise that Capcom is clearly invested in. The sustained success of titles like the **Resident Evil 4** remake and **Resident Evil Village** ensures that Capcom will continue to pour resources into both new entries and high-quality remasters. It signals a bright future for the series, promising more of the tense survival horror and compelling narratives that players have come to expect. The ongoing performance of older titles also means that new players can discover the series' rich history, while long-time fans have plenty of reasons to revisit their favorites or pick up titles they might have missed.

## What's Next

While specific details for future **Resident Evil** installments are kept under wraps, Capcom's investor relations have confirmed ongoing development and strong sales projections for upcoming titles. Players can anticipate further updates on the franchise's trajectory as Capcom continues to leverage its most profitable and beloved series.
